S.zh: 研究、内容、协调或轻量组件
S.en: research, content, coordination, or lightweight components

M.zh: 需要场地运营、可逆适配或持续人员
M.en: site operations, reversible adaptation, or sustained staffing

L.zh: 仅在正式资料和工程深化后讨论
L.en: discussion only after official data and engineering deepening

human_takeover.zh: 来源冲突交由数据管理角色与持证专业团队判定。
human_takeover.en: Source conflicts return to the data steward and licensed professional team.

stop_exit.zh: 来源冲突即冻结派生指标。
stop_exit.en: Freeze derived metrics when sources conflict.

maintenance.zh: 建议 4-8 周首轮并做季节复查。
maintenance.en: A suggested 4-8-week first pass plus seasonal review.

human_takeover.zh: 交通、无障碍与社区共设计人员共同确认断点和替代路线。
human_takeover.en: Transport, accessibility, and community co-design roles confirm barriers and fallback routes.

stop_exit.zh: 无许可或质量不足时只保留待调查清单。
stop_exit.en: Keep only a pending-survey list when permission or quality is insufficient.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 状态、人工接管与申诉协议
implementation_projects.title_en: Status, Human Takeover, and Appeal Protocol

maintenance.zh: 每个场景进入前测试并按季度复盘。
maintenance.en: Test before scenario entry and review quarterly.

human_takeover.zh: 责任角色接管服务、记录申诉并提供低技术替代。
human_takeover.en: The accountable role takes over service, records the appeal, and provides a low-tech fallback.

stop_exit.zh: 高风险误答或投诉无法闭环即停服。
stop_exit.en: Stop service when a high-risk error or complaint cannot be closed.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 众智园三类产业验证场景

maintenance.zh: 仅在有期限的受控测试窗口内逐次维护。
maintenance.en: Maintain per run within a time-limited controlled-test window.

human_takeover.zh: 安全或设施角色拒绝放行、隔离设备或结束测试。
human_takeover.en: Safety or facility roles refuse release, isolate equipment, or end the test.

stop_exit.zh: 专业条件或责任角色缺失即停止。
stop_exit.en: Stop when professional conditions or an accountable role are missing.

implementation_projects.title_zh: AI 原点成果匹配与共享中试
implementation_projects.title_en: AI Origin Matching and Shared Pilots

maintenance.zh: 建议 8-12 周服务原型并持续核验设施与权限。
maintenance.en: A suggested 8-12-week service prototype with continuing facility and permission checks.

human_takeover.zh: 人工顾问决定引荐、纠错或退回非 AI 服务。
human_takeover.en: A human adviser decides referral, correction, or reversion to a non-AI service.

stop_exit.zh: 泄露、持续误配或设施条件不明即回退人工。
stop_exit.en: Revert to humans for leakage, persistent mismatch, or unknown facility conditions.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 大钟寺产品试用与城市窗口
implementation_projects.title_en: Dazhongsi Product Trials and Urban Window

maintenance.en: Use time-limited rotations with per-event maintenance.

human_takeover.zh: 现场主持人随时停止 AI 展示、转人工说明并启动投诉流程。
human_takeover.en: The on-site host can stop the AI display, switch to a human explanation, and open the complaint process.

stop_exit.zh: 安全、权利、误导营销或投诉闭环失败即撤场。
stop_exit.en: Withdraw for safety, rights, misleading marketing, or failed complaint closure.

single_first_use.threshold_status: design-target or unknown unless externally evidenced

zh: 文保、生态、交通和结构专业条件
en: heritage, ecology, traffic, and structural conditions

maintenance.zh: 纸面或临时原型先行，进入前复核专业条件。
maintenance.en: Start with paper or temporary prototypes and recheck professional conditions before entry.

human_takeover.zh: 专业团队或运营角色可拒绝落地并保留纸面方案。
human_takeover.en: Professional or operating roles can refuse implementation and keep the proposal on paper.

stop_exit.zh: 文保、生态、交通、结构或权属不满足即不落地。
stop_exit.en: Do not implement when heritage, ecology, traffic, structure, or ownership conditions fail.

maintenance.zh: 小批量可逆试装并按月检查。
maintenance.en: Use a small reversible installation and inspect monthly.

human_takeover.zh: 维护或无障碍角色关闭信息功能并改用人工/静态组件。
human_takeover.en: Maintenance or accessibility roles disable information functions and use human/static components.

stop_exit.zh: 无维护主体、妨碍安全或不可达即撤除。
stop_exit.en: Remove when no maintainer exists, safety is obstructed, or accessibility fails.

maintenance.zh: 内容先审后展并按季度纠错。
maintenance.en: Review before display and correct quarterly.

human_takeover.zh: 历史、翻译或版权角色人工复核并替换争议内容。
human_takeover.en: History, translation, or rights roles manually review and replace disputed content.

stop_exit.zh: 史实争议、翻译误导或权利撤回即下架。
stop_exit.en: Remove disputed history, misleading translation, or withdrawn rights.

maintenance.zh: 持续维护并每半年复核。

human_takeover.zh: 社区运营与数据治理角色处理纠错、状态变更和撤回。
human_takeover.en: Community operations and data-governance roles handle corrections, status changes, and withdrawal.

stop_exit.zh: 无证据、无同意或不可纠错的记录即移除。
stop_exit.en: Remove records without evidence, consent, or correction access.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 年度活动与开发者社区

maintenance.zh: 按候选年历逐项申请、复核和批准。
maintenance.en: Apply, review, and approve item by item against the candidate calendar.

human_takeover.zh: 活动责任人可取消 AI 环节、切换人工流程或取消活动。
human_takeover.en: The event owner can cancel the AI element, switch to a human process, or cancel the event.

stop_exit.zh: 无责任人、资源或风险 Gate 不通过即取消。
stop_exit.en: Cancel when responsibility, resources, or a risk gate are missing.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 外部区域候选协同接口

current_readiness.activation: written authorization + first-party factual basis + named accountable interface lead

zh: RI01—RI05 逐接口授权范围与具名责任角色
en: per-interface authorization scope and named accountable roles for RI01–RI05

zh: visual/assets/regional-interface-contracts.json 中五域首件交付与停止合同
en: five-domain first-deliverable and stop contracts in visual/assets/regional-interface-contracts.json

maintenance.zh: 先维护非约束议题清单；每次授权变化即复核。
maintenance.en: Maintain a non-binding issue list first and recheck whenever authorization changes.

zh: 五项合同、零授权、零运行的状态一致性
en: state consistency of five contracts, zero authorizations, and zero operating interfaces

human_takeover.zh: 项目联络人与机构授权角色人工确认每个对外接口。
human_takeover.en: Project liaisons and authorized institutional roles manually confirm every external interface.

stop_exit.zh: 任一接口无逐范围书面授权、一手事实依据或具名京张责任角色，不得交换、运行或公开称合作；出现禁止输入、误导措辞或停止条件即撤回该接口材料。
stop_exit.en: Without per-scope written authorization, first-party factual basis, and a named Jing-Zhang accountable role, an interface may not exchange, operate, or be described as a partnership; prohibited input, misleading wording, or a stop trigger withdraws its material.

implementation_projects.title_zh: 正式资料到位后的全量重算

zh: 九类图层及全部载体重算清单
en: recomputation list for nine layers and all carriers

maintenance.zh: 每次权威资料变化触发同批重算。
maintenance.en: Trigger one-batch recomputation on every authoritative change.

human_takeover.zh: 各专业责任人复核替换范围并决定重新发布。
human_takeover.en: Accountable professionals review the replacement scope and decide republication.

stop_exit.zh: 新旧版本不一致时暂停发布旧指标。
stop_exit.en: Suspend publication of old metrics when versions conflict.
